sections.title: Crime trend over years

sections.output:
yearly = df.groupby('year').size()

year            2012  2013  2014  2015  2016

Linear slope (np.polyfit): +97.9 crimes/year | 2016 share: 98.4% | complete years (12 months): 0

         has all 12 months. Earlier years only contain crimes reported late. The crime-rate trend cannot be determined from this
         extract.
